subject: Warm handoff: Verdant Labs MAP & 3-phase activation slate
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyengar <sanjay@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Warm handoff: Verdant Labs MAP & 3-phase activation slate

Sanjay — attaching the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high level 3-phase activation slate so CS and engineering can start scoping. Key asks for you: confirm the three milestone windows and who will own the internal tasks on your side.

Quick summary (attachments: verdant_map_v1.xlsx, sow_draft_v2.pdf):
- Phase 1 (Discovery + API access): 2 weeks — Verdant IT to provide test keys and sample data by 2025-06-03.
- Phase 2 (Integration + Pilot): 4 weeks — integration owner: Verdant platform team (Sanjay). Redwood owner: Rishi (integration lead).
- Phase 3 (Go-live + Handover): 2 weeks — production cutover and runbook transfer; Redwood CS (Marissa) leads adoption.

Proposed kickoff: 2025-06-02 (30–45 minute kickoff). If that works, I will: 1) update MAP with committed owner names/dates, 2) upload to the shared drive, and 3) route the SOW for DocuSign.

Notes and open items:
- Procurement requested a final SOW with payment milestones — attached draft (sow_draft_v2.pdf).
- Security questionnaire will be needed, but we can run that parallel to Phase 1.

Next step: please reply with confirmation of the kickoff date and the Verdant owners for the three phases.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Sanjay Iyengar <sanjay@verdantlabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@verdantlabs.com>, procurement@verdantlabs.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm handoff: Verdant Labs MAP & 3-phase activation slate

Kimberly — thanks for the packet and the clear breakdown. We reviewed quickly with platform and procurement. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Phase 1: test keys and a sample data export — owner: Platform Ops (me). We expect to deliver by EOD 2025-06-04 (one-day buffer).
- Phase 2: integration owner will be Priya Shah (platform eng lead) — I will loop her into the kickoff if we lock the date.
- Phase 3: go-live window is fine but we need a short blackout window from our side for database exports; I flagged this for the SRE team.

Procurement asked if the payment milestones in the SOW can be aligned to go-live (50%) and 30-days-post (50%). Leah is cc'd to chime in on procurement timing.

Kickoff: 2025-06-02 works for us in the AM PT. Please propose a 30–45 minute agenda.

Appreciate the structure — attaching our preliminary runbook fragment (will send full list after kickoff).

—Sanjay
Sanjay Iyengar
Director, Platform Engineering | Verdant Labs
sanjay@verdantlabs.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyengar <sanjay@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm handoff: Verdant Labs MAP & 3-phase activation slate

Thanks, Sanjay — good to have the owners. I updated the MAP (see verdant_map_v1.xlsx) with the owners you called out and added milestone targets that align to your go-live ask. Quick agenda for the 2025-06-02 kickoff (30 minutes):

1) Intros & objectives (5 mins)
2) Phase 1 checklist: test keys, sample data, security baseline (8 mins)
3) Phase 2 integration approach + pilot success criteria (8 mins)
4) Phase 3 cutover plan and blackout ops (5 mins)

Marissa (CS lead): please confirm adoption plan responsibilities and training cadence.
Rishi (Integration lead): please confirm scope and any infra prerequisites from Redwood.
Priyom (Customer Success Ops): I added you on operational handoff items — can you propose the week-after-kickoff 30-day plan?

Procurement note: Sanjay — happy to align SOW payment terms to go-live/30-days-post as you requested; will update and route for signature after kickoff.

Kimberly

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Iyengar <sanjay@verdantlabs.com>, Leah Park <leah.park@verdantlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm handoff: Verdant Labs MAP & 3-phase activation slate

Looping in a short operational checklist from CS so everyone has clarity ahead of kickoff. I'll own the 30-day plan post-kickoff and will deliver a one-page adoption calendar within 72 hours after kickoff. High-level RBAC and training items below for the MAP: 

- Access matrix: who gets read vs write keys (Verdant to confirm list by 2025-06-04).
- Initial playbooks: 3 runbooks (integration triage, data anomalies, cutover rollback) — Redwood owners: Rishi (integration triage), Marissa (adoption/triage), Priyom (cutover & rollback).
- Success metrics for pilot: 95% inference availability during pilot window, <5% error rate on sample dataset, acceptance sign-off by Verdant product manager.

I will prepare the 30/60/90 day cadence doc and link it into the shared drive after kickoff. For now, can we lock the 2025-06-02 kickoff at 09:00 PT?

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Leah Park <leah.park@verdantlabs.com>

Subject: Re: Warm handoff: Verdant Labs MAP & 3-phase activation slate

Kimberly / Sanjay — 09:00 PT on 2025-06-02 works for procurement and platform. A few procurement asks before kickoff: 

- Please include payment milestone language that calls out the exact invoice trigger (we prefer "production cutover confirmed by Verdant product manager").
- Add an appendix for data retention and audit logs cadence (we will need 90-day log retention as part of the contract).

We will aim to have the list of privileged users for Phase 1 by 2025-06-04 EOD. Thanks for aligning on the SOW payment schedule — procurement will review the updated SOW after the kickoff.

Regards,
Leah Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | Verdant Labs
leah.park@verdantlabs.com

2) Upload revised MAP (verdant_map_v1.xlsx -> verdant_map_v1.1.xlsx) to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VerdantMAP

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.
